name: Silver Coast, Portugal

visa.notes: D7 visa requires proof of passive income. NHR ended Jan 2024; IFICI replacement excludes pensions.

rent.notes: Asking rents Aug 2026: Caldas da Rainha 8.75 EUR/m2, Obidos 10.47 EUR/m2 (~875-1050 for 100 m2); live listings: T2 house Obidos 120 m2 900 EUR, T3 apartment Caldas 144 m2 1300 EUR; Obidos T2 950-1100, T3 house 1300-1600; Numbeo 3BR Caldas 1010 outside centre / 1272 centre.

groceries.notes: National supermarket basket for a couple 350-600 EUR (Porto survey used as proxy; small-town prices slightly lower) plus ~70-90 EUR large-breed dog food. Unprocessed food CPI +3.7% y/y Oct 2026 flash.

sources.title: Euro Dicas - Custo de vida no Porto (values checked May 2026, updated Oct 2026)
E-konomista - Quanto custa ter um cao (dog food and grooming prices; 2018 article)

utilities.notes: Numbeo Caldas da Rainha basic utilities 96.50 EUR for 85 m2; a 2-3BR house with electric/gas heating in damp coastal winters runs higher, and energy CPI is +17.4% y/y (Oct 2026). Excludes internet.

sources.title: Numbeo - Cost of Living in Caldas da Rainha (updated 2 Oct 2026)

healthcare.notes: SNS is essentially free for legal residents (GP visits free since 2022), so this is the private top-up cover retiree couples typically carry: domestic comprehensive plans for a couple both aged 60 run about 250-360 EUR/month combined (basic hospital-only plans for two ~140-200). Former stored value excluded the insurance that was parked in 'insurance'; renewal increases of 8-15%/yr after 60 are common.

sources.title: Apoio Juridico Imigracao - Portugal private health insurance for expats 2026 (premiums by age, couple both 60)

insurance.notes: Re-modeled from old template (stored value was health insurance). DECO Sep 2026: tenant contents policy on 30,000 EUR of contents incl. seismic cover costs 39.68-76.52 EUR in Faro/Lisboa (Porto 46.81-92.10) per year, so about 4-8 EUR/month; tenant-specific extras can add a little.

sources.title: DECO Proteste - Melhor seguro casa para inquilinos (Sep 2026, contents 30k EUR premiums Faro/Lisboa/Porto)

petCare.notes: Basic consult 27.65 EUR, annual vaccines 30-50, flea/tick ~6/month and internal deworming ~4/quarter; large-dog doses cost more and a senior Bernese usually adds bloodwork and 1-2 extra visits, so ~300-1200 EUR/yr.

sources.title: Generali Tranquilidade - Preco consulta veterinario (Apr 2025: consult 27.65 EUR, vaccines 30-50, deworming)

petDaycare.notes: Dog hotels average ~15 EUR/night nationally (range 4-26, 75 hotels surveyed); occasional boarding/daycare of 5-10 days a month.

sources.title: DECO Proteste - Hoteis para caes e gatos: quanto custam por noite (75 hotels, avg 15 EUR/night, 2024)

transportation.notes: Car needed on the Silver Coast: ~800 km/month at 2.0-2.2 EUR/L (gasoleo 2.205, gasolina 2.006 on 2 Nov 2026) ~110, insurance avg ~344 EUR/yr (~29), maintenance/IUC/inspection ~50; Numbeo Caldas gasoline 1.75 EUR/L is the lower bound.

sources.title: Caetano - Preco dos combustiveis esta semana (2-8 Nov 2026: gasoleo 2.205, gasolina 95 2.006 EUR/L, DGEG)
E-konomista - Seguro automovel mais caro em 2026 (avg premium ~344 EUR/yr, +11.4%)

entertainment.notes: Fiber 1 Gbps 29-45 EUR (Numbeo Caldas 35), streaming ~30, mid-range meal for two 45 EUR x3, plus activities.

clothing.notes: Numbeo Porto: jeans 92.50 EUR, chain-store dress 29.71, Nike runners 83.75, leather shoes 92.89; a few items per month for two fits the stored 80 (national proxy for Silver Coast).

sources.title: Numbeo - Cost of Living in Porto (updated 8 Nov 2026)

phoneCell.notes: Two lines: Digi unlimited 6 EUR each (14 total), MEO/NOS unlimited 12.99-13 each (~26), Vodafone unlimited 20 each (40). Stored 85 was far above current market after the 2025-2026 price war.

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: SNS user fees are small; private consult without insurance ~85 EUR, with insurance co-pay ~17 EUR, elective procedure co-pays up to ~250 EUR. Stored range kept as consistent with these.

sources.title: Nomad Gate community - Health insurance in Portugal (private visit ~85 EUR, insured co-pay ~17 EUR)

healthcare.system: SNS public healthcare. Caldas da Rainha has a regional hospital. Larger facilities accessible in Lisbon (1 hour).
healthcare.waitTimes: Longer waits in smaller towns (4-8 weeks for specialists)
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Standard SNS prescription coverage with co-pays

pros: Close to Lisbon (1 hour) while maintaining small-town feel

cons.text: Smaller expat community than Algarve or Lisbon
Cooler and windier than southern Portugal
Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country

stateIncomeTax.exemptions: NHR ended Jan 2024 (IFICI replacement excludes pensions). Foreign pensions/retirement income taxed at standard progressive rates 12.5-48%. US-Portugal treaty provides foreign tax credit.

taxes.notes: NHR ended Jan 2024. IFICI replacement excludes pensions. Standard progressive rates 14.5%-48%.
